description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa near the rear/upper area facing the TV on the opposite wall; dining table with six chairs positioned centrally in the living zone.. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, straight corridor, medium length. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed not visible from front door, not visible from kitchen. Sleeping alcove offers slight visual separation but cooking smells reach the sleeping area. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children; households needing separate private bedrooms; roommates wanting individual rooms; anyone requiring a home office with a dedicated desk.
not_suitable_for: anyone requiring a home office with a dedicated desk
